name: Euro prices (Bulgaria)
description: For shops in Bulgaria after the euro changeover: checks that the shop sells in euro only, and can show prices in leva next to the euro at the fixed rate 1.95583 (ЗВЕРБ: mandatory 08.08.2025–08.08.2026, optional since).

settings.label: Also show prices in leva
settings.help: Adds the amount in leva after every euro price, e.g. "10,00 € (19,56 лв.)", same size and colour. Required in Bulgaria from 08.08.2025 to 08.08.2026; optional since.

settings.label: Stop showing leva after
settings.help: Optional date (YYYY-MM-DD). Empty: as long as the setting above is on.

author: PN Scripts
